about: A change that is not on the whitelist (the search's FDR): no proposal; the help says what FDR is and what can be proposed.
question: Change the FDR to 5% for this experiment.

model.content:
The FDR of the search is FragPipe's: it keeps peptides and proteins at 1% FDR by default [help:glossary.fdr].

It is not one of the changes the assistant can propose (a retry, a sample's condition, leaving a sample out, one analysis setting from a short list, a condition's role) [help:faq.assistant-proposal].
